headline: Weathered Expanse Swings to Wardens; Stlican Shelf Erupts
war_summary: Since the previous dispatch, the returns have shifted sharply. Weathered Expanse, already the busiest theatre, has changed complexion: six Warden strongpoints to three Colonial, with fifty-eight events on the twenty-four-hour file and fresh activity at the cutoff. Stlican Shelf has reawakened, showing eight events in the latest two hours; the current ledger reads five Wardens, four Colonials. LinnMercy continues hot with twenty-seven day events and its newest at 08:20. Stonecradle, quiet at last filing, has also stirred, leaving one position in no-man's-land alongside five Warden and three Colonial strongpoints. Viper Pit has flared late, logging five events in the latest two hours around Blackthroat. Fishermans Row has cooled after its earlier burst, with two events in the latest two hours and no new file after 07:31; ownership remains seven Wardens, one Colonial, and one position in no-man's-land. Callahan's Passage, for all its heavy casualty sheets, still shows no strongpoint event since 02:55. Godcrofts and DeadLands, busy in past files, are quiet at present.
